classification.difficultyReason: Read roots and an additional point from each graph, choose a suitable quadratic form and substitute to determine its scale factor. The vertex guides supply the needed coordinates, so the representation change leads to routine linked calculations.

content.prompt: Find the equations of the quadratic functions sketched below.

spec.description: Upward-opening parabola with labelled roots −5 and 2 and y-intercept −10. Arrowheads continue both branches. No grid or vertex coordinates are supplied.
spec.mathematics: The graph has roots −5 and 2 and passes through (0,−10).
spec.answerVisibility: Only source-supplied graphical features are visible; the equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The roots are $-5$ and $2$, so write $y=a(x+5)(x-2)$. Use the intercept $(0,-10)$:
$$\begin{align*}-10&=a(0+5)(0-2)\\-10&=-10a\\a&=1\end{align*}$$
Hence $y=(x+5)(x-2)$.

spec.description: Upward-opening parabola through the unlabelled origin and labelled root 6. Dashed guides locate the vertex at (3,−18), with 3 above the x-axis. Both curve branches have continuation arrows. No grid is supplied.
spec.mathematics: The roots are 0 and 6; the vertex is (3,−18).
spec.answerVisibility: Source-supplied intercept and vertex guides remain visible; the equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The roots are $0$ and $6$, so write $y=ax(x-6)$. Use the vertex $(3,-18)$:
$$\begin{align*}-18&=a(3)(3-6)\\-18&=-9a\\a&=2\end{align*}$$
Hence $y=2x(x-6)$.

spec.description: Downward-opening parabola through the unlabelled origin and labelled root 8. Dashed guides locate the vertex at (4,8). Both downward branches have continuation arrows. The root label is placed above-right to avoid the descending curve. No grid is supplied.
spec.mathematics: The roots are 0 and 8; the vertex is (4,8).
spec.answerVisibility: Source-supplied intercept and vertex guides remain visible; the equation is withheld.

answer.worked:
The roots are $0$ and $8$, so write $y=ax(x-8)$. Use the vertex $(4,8)$:
$$\begin{align*}8&=a(4)(4-8)\\8&=-16a\\a&=-\frac12\end{align*}$$
Hence $y=-\frac12x(x-8)$.
